one_line: Frontier Gurjara-Pratihara ruler who checked Arab expansion beyond Sindh in the mid-8th century.

appearance.face: oval face, wheatish-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, thick arched brows, short neatly trimmed moustache and light stubble; default expression is calm, alert determination with a hint of sternness
appearance.hair: thick black hair tied into a medium-length topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothed back; a narrow golden cloth headband with a simple central knot holds the hair, no crown or ornate crest
appearance.costume: knee-length, long-sleeved cotton angarkha-style tunic in muted brick-red, wrapping left over right and tied with cloth ties; over it a sleeveless quilted cotton coat (padded vest) in dull indigo with simple vertical stitch lines, reaching just above the knees; a broad dark-brown leather belt with a plain bronze buckle sits at the waist, from which hangs a small utility pouch; lower body in tightly wrapped off-white cotton churidar-style leggings; on feet, mid-calf brown leather boots with slightly upturned toes, stitched but unornamented; forearms wrapped with dark indigo cloth bracers; a plain off-white cotton dupatta is looped once from left shoulder to right hip for modest drape; jewellery minimal—a single small circular copper earring in the left ear and a narrow copper bangle on the right wrist.
appearance.signature: a straight, broad-bladed one-handed iron sword with a slightly tapering blade, simple crossguard, round iron pommel and a dark leather-wrapped grip, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left side

ref_desc: Nagabhata I has an oval wheatish-brown face with a short moustache and topknot bound by a golden headband, wearing a brick-red angarkha, indigo quilted vest, off-white leggings, brown boots, and belt-hung plain leather-scabbarded straight sword in muted reds, blues, and browns.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nagabhata I: an early-30s, athletic Gurjara-Pratihara warlord with an oval wheatish-brown face, straight nose, sharp jawline, thick brows, short neatly trimmed moustache and light stubble, his expression calm and alert with a hint of sternness. His thick black hair is pulled into a medium topknot at the back of the crown, held by a narrow golden cloth headband tied in front. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved brick-red cotton angarkha-style tunic wrapping left over right, covered by a sleeveless dull indigo quilted cotton vest that reaches just above his knees, with visible vertical stitch lines. A broad dark-brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle sits at his waist, carrying a small pouch and suspending a plain dark-brown leather scabbard on his left hip. His legs are in tightly wrapped off-white churidar-style leggings, and his feet in mid-calf brown leather boots with slightly upturned toes. His forearms are wrapped with dark indigo cloth bracers, and a modest off-white cotton dupatta loops from his left shoulder to right hip for added drape. Jewellery is minimal: a single small circular copper earring in the left ear and a narrow copper bangle on his right wrist. In his hand or resting at his side is his signature straight, one-handed iron sword with a broad slightly tapering blade, simple crossguard, round iron pommel, and dark leather-wrapped grip. Use a restrained palette of brick red, dull indigo, off-white, dark brown, and copper, and show him from multiple angles to fix his consistent hairstyle, clothing, and weapon details.
